title: Homogeneity of the discrete derivative
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $i$ be a coordinate of the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $c$ be a real number, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on that cube. The discrete derivative in coordinate $i$ of $c f$ equals $c$ times the discrete derivative of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
